hook: The SU(2) BFSS ground state, solved numerically, matches matrix bootstrap results to five figures.
summary: The authors solve for the ground-state wavefunction of SU(2) BFSS matrix quantum mechanics and check it against bootstrap bounds and a known three-point amplitude. They also extract four-point scattering with Luscher's method, find the expected v^4/r^7 interaction, and report bound states and resonances. The gauge group is only SU(2), so the results may not carry over to large N.
title: Solving the SU(2) BFSS model
